prereg.loss: calib.loss_of(ev, delay=False): <1-Dice>_t + <d_bnd>_t/BND_SCALE + stage-end fine-line count error; mean over the calibration patterns (equal weights)
prereg.selection: best = lowest mean calibration loss over all CMA samples of the three inits (calib.calibrate); initial points evaluated as references only
prereg.failures: exception / ledger ok=False / wall > 1200 s -> +inf (1e6 for CMA), counted
prereg.never: test patterns are not used to choose initialisation, parameters, thresholds or time alignment
